input_signal: Provider page showed Microsoft sign-in while retained Badu auth expectation was Google SSO.
decision: Record provider as live-recheck blocked, retain prior captured baseline, and continue other providers.
lesson: Do not stop a full SOP run on one provider login blocker; isolate the blocker and preserve coverage elsewhere.

input_signal: Workbook had OpenAI evidence as screenshot-only but live billing history showed the same two paid rows.
decision: Update row/source evidence to live billing history without changing transaction totals.
lesson: Evidence quality can improve even when financial data is unchanged; track source freshness separately from amounts.

input_signal: New Stripe payments appeared in Balance activity, but payment detail pages did not prove a match to owner-supplied test accounts.
decision: Import as customer revenue with an uncertainty note instead of reclassifying as testing expense.
lesson: Testing-expense classification requires proof; do not infer from timing or suspicion.

input_signal: Stripe Balance activity showed refunds tied to prior owner/test purchases.
decision: Add negative Testing expense rows so refunds reduce prior test-purchase cost.
lesson: For this workbook convention, test refunds are negative expenses, not revenue.

input_signal: Vercel showed an upcoming estimated invoice for the current billing cycle.
decision: Exclude the upcoming estimate and import only paid invoice rows.
lesson: Monthly SOP should use paid invoices and posted activity; estimates belong outside actuals.

input_signal: Google Sheets connector readback worked but batch update failed with insufficient write scope.
decision: Use bounded Chrome UI range paste and verify by connector/copy-back readback.
lesson: Manual UI writes are acceptable fallback only when range and verification are explicit.
